observations: The resident BIOS error vector stored at file 0x764 is 01d5:06f5.
Applying the candidate file base 0x1c50 to offset 06f5 identifies the independently located BIOS selector routine at file 0x2345.
The same file base maps 01d5:2da6 to file 0x49f6, where the word is 01a2h.
The word at 49f6 is the resource length: resource table start 49f0 plus 01a2h reaches the IOSYSMSG marker at 4b92.
If the startup routine reads that loaded resource word unchanged, its aligned contribution is 01c0h and the two copy loops span 2f30h.
limitations: The vector and image contents strongly support the mapping, but no runtime trace establishes that the memory word remains unmodified at the read.
The copy span is not proven to equal the BIOS_CODE size used by GETSIZE; the relation to target BDSIZE and origin remains unresolved.
